_status_note: Phase 0 doc-type recon output only. This file records verified county identity, the canonical parcel key contract, and the source inventory. It does NOT carry the full v5.0.0 18-field proof packet per source and will NOT validate against config/counties/_schema.json. The validated config is a Phase 0 Step 4 artifact and MUST be produced via scaffold/ops/write_county_config.py, never hand-written. See recon/marion-in-recon.md.
build_verdict_reason: Indiana Courts MyCase is an unblocked, daily-refresh, fully scriptable primary distress source (undocumented open JSON API, no auth, no enforced CAPTCHA, no observed rate limiting). Parcel enrichment is open and nightly. P0 gate satisfied.

segment_structure.sub_parcel_suffix: .NNN — .000 for a whole parcel, non-zero for splits and condo units

canonical_join_key.secondary_required_reason: The IndyGIS/MapIndy layer family (Abandoned and Vacant layer 11/16 keyed PARCEL_I; Registered Landlord layer 27 keyed PARCEL_C) is unreachable without the local key. The canonical state key is unreachable for those layers. Both must be stored.
canonical_join_key.do_not_join_on_reason: Internal assessor CAMA id with no presence in any other source.
canonical_join_key.relationship: STATEPARCELNUMBER, PARCEL_I, PARCEL_C and CAMAPARCELID are strictly 1:1. Verified both directions on the largest duplicate group.
canonical_join_key.row_uniqueness_note: The parcel layer is NOT row-unique on any key — multi-polygon parcels repeat up to 30x. Every ingest MUST dedupe on the canonical key or counts inflate. Query with returnGeometry=false.
canonical_join_key.crosswalk_layer: MapIndyProperty/MapServer/10 — the only place both keys appear together

normalization_fields.parcel_id_state: STATEPARCELNUMBER verbatim, punctuation preserved, uppercase, trimmed
normalization_fields.parcel_id_state_n: digits only, punctuation stripped, fixed width 18

canonical_join_key.derivation_rule: Sources without a parcel id (courts, code enforcement, sheriff sale, tax sale) must derive the key via the address bridge. A derived key MUST carry its derivation method and confidence and MUST route to the review queue below threshold. Never silently accept a fuzzy parcel match.
